integrity: The proof is analytic. The new step is a finite-index torus-covering lemma replacing the unimodular zero-set lemma; the remainder is checked against the stated hypotheses of the source paper post-finiteness argument. No finite experiment is used to infer the infinite-dimensional conclusion.
scientific_limitations: The result covers rational rank two only when the marked core has positive integer symplectic area. It does not classify noninteger supercritical areas and does not address the subcritical counterexample regime.
title: Integer-area mixed-arithmetic four-point Gabor independence
